3.name: Fiend Spells
3.notes:
You always have the following spells prepared at the listed Warlock levels:

3rd: Burning Hands, Command, Scorching Ray, Suggestion
5th: Fireball, Stinking Cloud
7th: Fire Shield, Wall of Fire
9th: Geas, Insect Plague

3.name: Dark One's Blessing
3.notes: When you reduce an enemy to 0 Hit Points, you gain Temporary Hit Points equal to your Charisma modifier + your Warlock level (minimum 1 THP). You also gain these Temporary Hit Points if an enemy within 10 feet of you is reduced to 0 Hit Points by someone else.

6.name: Dark One's Own Luck
6.notes:
When you make an ability check or a saving throw, you can add 1d10 to the roll. You can decide to use this feature after seeing the roll but before any of its effects occur.

Uses: a number of times equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum 1), at most once per roll. All expended uses are regained after a Long Rest.

10.name: Fiendish Resilience
10.notes: Whenever you finish a Short or Long Rest, choose one damage type other than Force. You have Resistance to that damage type until you choose a different one with this feature.

14.name: Hurl Through Hell
14.notes:
Once per turn when you hit a creature with an attack roll, you can force it to make a Charisma saving throw against your spell save DC. On a failed save, the target disappears, hurtling through the Lower Planes, and returns at the end of your next turn to the space it left or the nearest unoccupied space.

On a failed save, if the target isn't a Fiend, it takes 8d10 Psychic damage and has the Incapacitated condition until it returns.

Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a Long Rest, unless you expend a Pact Magic spell slot (no action required) to restore its use.
